headline: Millonaria fuga de doláres de Paraguay a la Argentina
content: ASÚNCIÓN (EFE) The president of Paraguay, Federico Franco denounced a large flight of dollars from Paraguay to Argentina due to exchange controls in neighboring countries, which according to government estimates resulted in $200 million leaving during May alone. Following the approval of money laundering laws, Argentinians and their relatives have been returning dollars previously sent to Paraguay and Uruguay.

headline: No cesan protestas en Turquia y el Gobierno no cede
content: ESTAMBUL (EFE) After a week of protests, both the Turkish Government and those occupying Gezi Parks Taksim Square refuse to back down. While authorities demand immediate cessation of demonstrations, protesters warn they wont leave until plans for park redevelopment among other demands cease.

headline: VENEZUELA. OPISICIÓN PIDE DEPURACIÓN DEL CONSEJO NACIONAL ELECTORAL
content: Up to 400 thousand deceased individuals authorized to vote, Maduro willing to smooth relations with Santos thanks to mediation by Lula Da Silva. CARACAS  (Venezuelan agencies) Venezuelan opposition requests Council National Election purification claiming possession of records showing up to 181,000 dead persons still listed active voters despite death certificates proving otherwise. Opposition claims actual numbers could reach upwards of 400,000 plus some more. Municipal elections scheduled next December allow registration modifications including newly registered voters. Despite awaiting Supreme Court decisions regarding April 14th Presidential Elections challenges, negotiations between Nicolas Maduro and Colombian counterpart Juan Manuel Santos proceed facilitated by Brazilian Ex-president Luis Ignacio Lula Da Silva.

headline: Temperatura récord en Lima
content: Lima registra su menor temperatura en tres años. El jueves último, la temperatura mínima de Lima, medida en el Aeropuerto Jorge Chávez, descendió a 13.9°C. Esta baja marca no es frecuente durante el otoño. Además, en La Molina ya se han registrado temperaturas entre 11°C y 12°C debido al frío intenso del Pacífico ecuatoriano.

headline: Ventiscas causan estragos en Arequipa
